raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `--kv-events-config`, a KV-aware router (sgl-router, or Dynamo) builds its view of each worker's cache from the BlockStored / BlockRemoved stream. During decode, the scheduler publishes that stream only every `decode_log_interval` steps (40 by default). Blocks inserted when a request finishes, and blocks evicted to make room for decode, reach the router up to 40 steps late, and a follow-up turn that arrives in that window is routed on a stale view.

Prefill publishes after every batch, so mixed workers partly hide this. PD decode workers run only decode batches, so they always lag.

## Modifications

`report_decode_stats` called `publish_kv_events()` after its periodic early return, so 39 of 40 decode steps skipped it. The call now runs before that return, so every decode step publishes, as every prefill batch already does. On ranks without a publisher it is a no-op, and a step with no events costs one `take_events()` call.

## Accuracy Tests

New case in `test/registered/unit/observability/test_forward_pass_metrics.py`: a real `SchedulerKvEventsPublisher` behind the metrics reporter, one queued event, one decode step that is not a log step.

- main: `AssertionError: Lists differ: [] != [[<object ...>]]` (nothing published)
- this PR: passes (the file: 34 passed)

CPU only. I have not measured the effect on a live router.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: one extra queue drain per decode step, on the publishing rank only.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Not applicable.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Related: #44516 (decode cache affinity reads these events).

             if x := self.scheduler_status_logger:
                 x.maybe_dump(batch, self.scheduler.waiting_queue)
 
+        # Routers build their cache view from KV events, so flush them every step.
+        self.scheduler.kv_events_publisher.publish_kv_events()

         # Periodic work: log + heavy metrics at decode_log_interval
         if self.forward_ct_decode % self.decode_log_interval != 0:

 )

+class TestDecodeKvEvents(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_decode_step_publishes_queued_kv_events(self):
+        """KV events queued during decode must reach the publisher in the same
+        step, not only on decode_log_interval steps."""
+        event = object()
+        kv_events_publisher = SchedulerKvEventsPublisher(
+            kv_events_config=None,

+        reporter.forward_ct_decode = 1

+        reporter.report_decode_stats(
+            can_run_cuda_graph=False, running_batch=types.SimpleNamespace()
+        )
+
+        batches = kv_events_publisher.kv_event_publisher.metrics
+        self.assertEqual([batch.events for batch in batches], [[event]])
